parsed.why: No trans-specific offence; 2019 sodomy law repealed 2020 and re-criminalisation rejected by the 2024 constitution. But police occasionally use modesty charges against gender-nonconforming people, individual harassment is common, no gender-identity protection, thin recourse, no border data.

Hate-crime law enumerates gender identity, anti-discrimination and marker framework exist, LGBT centres operate, guides report wide acceptance. Countervailing: inconsistent enforcement, inadequate hate-crime investigation, trans search friction, anti-gender rhetoric, a disrupted Pride. No documented trans violence or state targeting.

Colonial sodomy felonies (up to 14 years) remain in force and reach trans women read as male; no prosecution documented since 2013, but silence in a thin-data state is not safety. No gender-identity protection or recourse; an embedded third-gender tradition softens presentation norms.

Penal code criminalises same-sex conduct with documented enforcement: mass arrest, prison terms resting on 'gay appearance'. Police complicit in vigilante killings and beatings with impunity; care effectively banned; no advocacy, venues or recourse. Severe, active exposure.

State-imposed border exposure: sex-at-birth marker rules, refusal instructions, detentions, stranded travellers, allied advisories; facility bans with criminal trespass and a documented arrest; custody abuse. Partly offset by national hate-crime coverage, marriage recognition and protective states.
